selector.rationale: Microcephaly, ventricular enlargement, and severe thinning of the frontal, parietal, and occipital lobes are consistent with Fetal Akinesia Deformation Sequence, which is also supported by the death of the identical twin in utero.

rejected.label: Optic Nerve Hypoplasia
rejected.why: While optic nerve pallor and weak light reflexes are present, they are not sufficient to explain the overall brain abnormalities.

rejected.label: Congenital Hydrocephalus
rejected.why: The presence of microcephaly and ventricular enlargement without elevated intracranial pressure is not typical of Congenital Hydrocephalus.

rejected.label: Monochorionic Diamniotic Twinning Complications
rejected.why: While the twinning complications may have contributed to the condition, they do not specifically explain the brain abnormalities.
